issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

localRoot.description:
local path to read packages. Path can end at folder that has *.c3pkg.json or parent folder up to two levels deep
that has many packages.
e.g:  /User/c3.developer/repo/server/common -> [./pacakge.json]
      /User/c3.developer/repo/server ->  [common/pacakge.json],
      /User/c3.developer/all/ ->  [base/foundation/foundation.c3pkg.json, ui/uicommon/uicommon.c3pkg.json]
